objective: Determine whether the five locally accepted layer-63 corrections other than expert 164 contain a model-KLD improvement that the complete panel and expert-164 singleton obscured.
evidence_boundary: The 16 public 512-token documents were already used to measure the complete layer-63 panel and the pre-registered expert-164 singleton. They are candidate-selection data for this plan. A winning subset requires confirmation on a new document-disjoint reference tier.

candidate_arms.name: accepted-experts-without-164
candidate_arms.reason: The complete accepted panel regressed less than expert 164 alone, so the remaining accepted corrections may contain an offsetting model-KLD gain.

candidate_arms.name: expert-29-alone
candidate_arms.reason: Measure the individual model effect without assuming that expert corrections combine additively.
